reason: Both failures have one cause: the original 0766 made BlockTables.apply_staged_writes() return unless append_block_ids() had set _dirty, so writes staged on the block tables directly (as both tests stage them) were neither applied nor cleared. Serving was not affected: production stages block-table writes only through append_block_ids(), which sets _dirty, and the declared-call mismatch was a declared fused write the test no longer launched (launched - declared was empty), not an undeclared launch. The correction skips only when nothing is staged and num_blocks is unchanged (the 1107 no-op case), so both tests pass unchanged, the series still applies, output stays bit-exact and the step-time gain holds beyond the interval on two boots at c1, c8 and c16.
